## Cast

Eight cast members from [season 47](Saturday_Night_Live_(season_47) "Saturday Night Live (season 47)") left the show prior to the beginning of this season, making it the biggest cast exodus since [1995](Saturday_Night_Live_(season_20) "Saturday Night Live (season 20)"). Returning cast member [Cecily Strong](Cecily_Strong "Cecily Strong") took a temporary leave of absence early in the season due to her commitments to perform in the Los Angeles revival of the one-woman stage play *[The Search for Signs of Intelligent Life in the Universe](The_Search_for_Signs_of_Intelligent_Life_in_the_Universe "The Search for Signs of Intelligent Life in the Universe"),* returning to *SNL* for the October 29, 2022, episode.[[8]](Saturday_Night_Live_(season_48)#cite_note-8) Strong then departed several weeks later on December 17 after being on the show for eleven seasons since [2012](Saturday_Night_Live_(season_38) "Saturday Night Live (season 38)"), making her the longest-tenured female cast member in the show's history.[[9]](Saturday_Night_Live_(season_48)#cite_note-9)

Subagents do not have access to the information you have retrieved in prior turns or your thoughts. You must provide each subagent with the necessary context it needs in its instructions.

**Michael Longfellow** (born January 31, 1994)[[1]](Michael_Longfellow#cite_note-1)[[2]](Michael_Longfellow#cite_note-PNTimes-2) is an American stand-up comedian, actor, and writer. Longfellow was hired to join the cast of the <NBC> [sketch comedy](Sketch_comedy "Sketch comedy") series *[Saturday Night Live](Saturday_Night_Live "Saturday Night Live")* as a featured player for its [48th season](Saturday_Night_Live_(season_48) "Saturday Night Live (season 48)") in 2022, making his debut alongside [Marcello Hernandez](Marcello_Hernandez "Marcello Hernandez"), [Molly Kearney](Molly_Kearney "Molly Kearney"), and [Devon Walker](Devon_Walker_(comedian) "Devon Walker (comedian)").

## Life and career

Longfellow was born and raised in [Phoenix, Arizona](Phoenix%2C_Arizona "Phoenix, Arizona"). His mother and divorce attorney father later divorced; Longfellow's comedy includes references to the fact that both his parents have remarried often, resulting in a collection of stepparents.

During his first year at [Arizona State University](Arizona_State_University "Arizona State University"), where he earned a [BA](Bachelor_of_Arts "Bachelor of Arts") in [English literature](English_literature "English literature"), Longfellow started performing stand-up comedy.[[2]](Michael_Longfellow#cite_note-PNTimes-2) After his 2016 graduation, he moved to Los Angeles,[[3]](Michael_Longfellow#cite_note-3) and started performing in comedy clubs across the country, as well as at the Netflix Is A Joke festival during its "Netflix Introducing..." showcase.[[4]](Michael_Longfellow#cite_note-4) He has also appeared on *[Conan](Conan_(talk_show) "Conan (talk show)")* and the NBC reality competition series *[Bring the Funny](Bring_the_Funny "Bring the Funny")*, co-hosted by his future *SNL* colleague, [Kenan Thompson](Kenan_Thompson "Kenan Thompson").

In 2022, it was announced that Longfellow would be joining the cast of *[Saturday Night Live](Saturday_Night_Live "Saturday Night Live")* (*SNL*) as a featured player for its [48th season](Saturday_Night_Live_(season_48) "Saturday Night Live (season 48)").[[5]](Michael_Longfellow#cite_note-5) On October 1, 2022, Longfellow made his *SNL* debut as a new featured cast member. In his first episode, he appeared on *[Weekend Update](Weekend_Update "Weekend Update")* to discuss anti-vaccination relatives and actress [Sydney Sweeney](Sydney_Sweeney "Sydney Sweeney")’s Trump-supporting family members.[[6]](Michael_Longfellow#cite_note-6)

Based on my Wikipedia search, here's information about Molly Kearney's career and filmography:

## Molly Kearney

**Born:** May 2, 1992 in Cleveland, Ohio, U.S.

**Medium:** Stand-up comedy, television, digital

**Alma Mater:** University of Dayton

### Career Highlights

- **Saturday Night Live (2022–present):** Molly Kearney joined the cast of NBC's *Saturday Night Live* as a featured player for the show's 48th season in 2022, making their debut alongside Marcello Hernandez, Michael Longfellow, and Devon Walker. Notably, Kearney became the **first openly non-binary cast member** in SNL history.

- **Stand-up Comedy:** Born and raised in Cleveland, Kearney frequently performed stand-up comedy in Chicago before moving to Los Angeles. In 2019, they were selected as one of the comedians for Comedy Central's "Up Next" showcase following a nationwide search.

### Filmography/Screen Credits

- **A League of Their Own (2022)** – Amazon Prime Video series
- **The Mighty Ducks: Game Changers (2021)** – Disney+ series

### Personal Information

- Uses **they/them pronouns**
- Based their early career on developing stand-up in Chicago's comedy scene before transitioning to television and Los Angeles

Molly Kearney represents a significant milestone as SNL's first openly non-binary cast member, bringing diversity to the sketch comedy institution while continuing to build their career in both stand-up comedy and television acting.
